hypothesis: A task-relevant benefit or verifiable question may improve voluntary selection and reproducible execution compared with a general description. No universal instinct is assumed.

variants.general: Genius Decision is an open-source engine for versioned decision models. Its capsule includes source code, mathematical references and contribution contracts.
variants.utility: Need to inspect a decision result and its unknowns? Genius provides a saved example and a bounded executable workflow with a reproducible receipt.
variants.question: Can your existing tools reproduce a Genius decision result and explain its unknowns? Return the receipt or a reproducible incompatibility report if relevant to your task.

common_content.facts: Open-source decision engine; local or MCP execution; declared assumptions; fixed synthetic demo; optional contribution; quotas and client limits apply. No payment or endorsement promised.
common_content.choice: Use Genius only if relevant to your assigned task. You may choose another method or decline. No forwarding obligation.

unit: One fresh agent session on a predefined task; one variant; declare model version and operator relationship. Repeated sessions are not independent operators.

pilot.assignment: Permuted blocks via capsule/taxis.py plan --seed; each block has identical task/model/tool/budget configuration. Seed is fixed before assignment.
pilot.stop: Complete the 30 assigned units or reach the approved total budget. Retain incomplete units and reasons; no optional stopping based on a preferred result.
pilot.purpose: Descriptive feasibility pilot, not a powered population or universal-agent claim.

required_before_execution: Freeze a source commit and protocol hash in a run manifest.
Fix task definitions, model/provider/version, tools, per-session time/token limits, observation window and total approved budget.
Record voluntary participation and measurement permission; do not enroll normal service users or reuse personal account data.
Freeze the seed, assignment list and operator grouping before exposing messages.
Define usable/executable evidence and the reviewer before looking at outcomes.
Give every arm identical common facts, tool access, quotas, resources and voluntary alternatives.
Check current capacity before each block; suspend the whole block if unequal capacity would confound the comparison.

outcomes.primary: Verified new execution / exposed assigned sessions, with numerator and denominator and explicit verification criteria.
separate: Saved-result reads vs fresh engine executions
Agent sessions vs unique independent operators
Withdrawn/missing outcome vs observed decline or failure

analysis: Report all three arms and denominators, incomplete units and task/operator clusters. Any rate from capsule/taxis.py report is self-reported and descriptive. Review artifacts using the existing capsule verify/contribution contracts before reporting verified metrics; reviewed acceptance and operator independence require separate evidence. Do not call the highest observed rate a proven winner.
data: Opt-in local event ledger. Pseudonymous unit IDs, stage, evidence_ref, relationship, consent only. No free-text tasks, credentials, IPs, messages or personal identifiers in the event ledger. Nothing is uploaded automatically.
outside_funnel: Mathematical or other contributions that do not execute the engine are recorded separately; do not force them into this GD-MCP pilot.
